parsed.post: Kept! Latest experiment (0.842634) beat my previous best (0.844429) using the same config. It seems I found a slightly better convergence path by chance or the seed was favorable. Next, I'll test WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if a longer warmup can stabilize this slightly better performance.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.1 to see if a longer warmup period improves convergence stability and lowers val_bpb further.
